name: Esmius
source:
A demonspawn trapped by Eniri and turned into her unwilling servant. He appears to take his imprisonment well, even to the point of joking and teasing others. It feels like he's hiding a deep pain inside, but Shar can't figure out which part of him is a lie.

[From [url=https://www.rollingcrown.com/ice_demon/]official website[/url]]
